description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_Strategy_RemoveForeignElements, which implements a strategy for removing or transforming unrecognized or foreign HTML tags during HTML purification. It contains the execute() method that processes tokens, applies transformations, and filters tags based on configuration.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Strategy_RemoveForeignElements
classes.description: A strategy class for removing or transforming foreign or unrecognized HTML elements during purification.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Processes a list of tokens, removing or transforming unrecognized or foreign tags based on configuration, and returns the filtered list of tokens.
